title: Build Curated Collections with Dual-State In-Situ Product Cards
description: Implement the Curated Collections product grid featuring dual-state cards inspired by India Circus: clean studio frame cutout on rest transitioning smoothly to styled living room in-situ photography on hover.
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards render crisp studio cutout imagery on default rest state
Hovering smoothly cross-fades to a styled interior room view showing the frame hung in context
Cards display standard dimensions (8x10, 11x14, 16x20, 24x36), starting price tags, and Quick View trigger
Quick Customize drawer opens with pre-selected moulding for 1-click configuration

steps.description: Create FrameCard component with dual-state image swap
steps.details: Build components/home/frame-card.tsx with Next.js Image optimization and cross-fade transition.
Create components/home/curated-collections.tsx displaying curated sets (The Minimalist, The Heritage, The Gallery Wall).

steps.description: Visual smoke check for card hover states
steps.details: Verify hover micro-interactions in Playwright and save screenshot.
